# LumoroX Park

> LumoroX Park is a marketplace for renting private driveways and parking spots by the hour, with QR check-in, live availability, and host trust scores.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What LumoroX Park is and how it works.
- [Browse parking](/browse): Search live private parking spots near you.
- [Sign in / Sign up](/auth): Create an account or sign in as a renter or host.
